extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners, patent practitioners, and stakeholders interested in design-patent examination policy or submitting comments
extracted.subtask_description: Federal Register notice correcting and announcing procedural details for the USPTO's supplemental guidance on examination of design patent applications that include computer-generated electronic images (e.g., icons and GUIs). It informs examiners and the public about applicability, corrected example formatting, comment procedures, and incorporation into the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of supplemental guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) published supplemental guidance to be used by USPTO personnel in determining whether a design claim including a computer-generated electronic image is directed to statutory subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This supplemental guidance is intended as examination guidance for USPTO personnel and addresses design claims that include computer-generated electronic images, including computer-generated icons and graphical user interfaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability date
rubrics_metrics.description: This supplemental guidance is applicable as of November 17, 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice corrects the DATES caption to state applicability as of November 17, 2023. Examiners and stakeholders should treat the guidance as effective from that date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments submission deadline and method
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received by November 18, 2024, to ensure consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit written comments through the Federal eRulemaking Portal at www.regulations.gov. See the ADDRESSES section in the November 17, 2023 notice for detailed submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections to examples (formatting)
rubrics_metrics.description: The USPTO has corrected Examples 2, 4, and 5 in Section (V) of the supplemental guidance to reproduce certain formatting (i.e., underlining and strikethrough) in the text necessary to understand the examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A PDF version of the examples containing the corrected formatting has been posted on the Examination Guidance and Training Materials page under 35 U.S.C. 171 at www.uspto.gov/patents/laws/examination-policy/examination-guidance-and-training-materials. The corrected examples should be used to interpret the guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation into the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplemental guidance, including the examples, will be incorporated into the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure in due course.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once incorporated, the guidance will form part of the official examiner practice materials in the MPEP; examiners and practitioners should monitor MPEP updates for the finalized text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point(s) of contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: For further information contact Erin Harriman or Carolyn Kosowski, Senior Legal Advisors, Office of Patent Legal Administration, with provided phone numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed contacts (Erin Harriman at 571-272-7747; Carolyn Kosowski at 571-272-7688) for questions regarding the supplemental guidance or the corrections noted in this Federal Register notice.
